title: 🔥宏观流动性处于防御模式
body: 市场处于宏观风险防御期。BMRI 指数为 75，处于 RISK_OFF 区间，意味着资金避险情绪浓厚且增量匮乏。当前资产定价高度依赖流动性，若油价下跌引发降息预期升温，将有效改善估值环境。中性。宏观拐点何时确立？
body_en: The market is in a defensive phase against macro risks. The BMRI is at 75, sitting in the RISK_OFF zone, signaling heavy risk aversion and a scarcity of fresh capital. Asset pricing is currently highly dependent on liquidity. If falling oil prices ignite rate cut expectations, it would effectively improve the valuation environment. Neutral. When will the macro inflection point be confirmed?
